title: Subset selection for matrices by volume sampling
summary: We address the Subset selection problem for matrices, where the goal is to select a subset $\mathcal{S}$ of $k$ column indices from a \enquote{short-and-fat} matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$, such that the sampled submatrix $X_{\mathcal{S}}$ has $\|X_{\mathcal{S}}^†X\|_F$ as small as possible. Our approach is centered on volume sampling, which attains the tightest known bound on this objective in expectation.
